name: TOI-1873
title: TOI-1873: linear ephemerides and O − C from 50 TESS mid-transit times
notes: Real data: 50 TESS mid-transit times of TOI-1873 (EXOTIC’s per-transit fits). The stored fit is a straight line per planet. On the Timing tab, pick a planet to see its O − C and the periodogram of the residuals: no peak passes the 1% false-alarm level, so there is no timing variation to explain. The next example asks how heavy a hidden perturber could be.
